photos.alt: Iced gingerbread cookies on a white plate beside a lit candle and dark fir branches, on a table in a dim, cosy room.
photos.notes: Dark calm top third is built for headline text; warm candle glow bottom right. Crop wide or tall; keep the plate in the lower half.

photos.alt: A hand piping white icing onto a gingerbread cookie, with other iced reindeer and star cookies on a pale table.
photos.notes: Portrait close-up, no faces. Bright and airy, so it sits well on cream panels; crop to a square around the piping bag and cookie.

photos.alt: Friends in colourful ugly Christmas sweaters laughing and hugging in a doorway, one holding a small wrapped gift box, with a baubled garland on the door beside them.
photos.notes: Warm, candid and fun with a wide frame. Works as a section photo or a rounded card; faces are mid-distance, not close-ups.

photos.alt: A white ceramic cup of hot chocolate piled with mini marshmallows on a wooden board, beside fir sprigs and a red ribbon, with soft fairy lights behind.
photos.notes: Soft white backdrop gives space for a caption on the upper half. Great for the cocoa bar menu; crop can go wide or square.

photos.alt: A dim, cosy living room with a softly lit Christmas tree glowing behind a sofa and a coffee table with a mug and a book.
photos.notes: Portrait, very moody and warm; the tree sits in the upper left. Good as a tall side image or a dark band behind light text.

photos.alt: A gift wrapped in kraft paper with a red patterned band and ribbon, beside a candy cane, a gingerbread man and pine branches on a dark wooden table.
photos.colors: kraft brown, cranberry red, pine green
photos.notes: Top-down flat lay with the ribbon trailing off to the right. Ideal for the packaging checklist; crops well to wide or square.

photos.alt: Overhead view of a red-rimmed oval tin lined with baking paper and packed with dark gingerbread cookies iced in white, beside a fir sprig with warm fairy lights glowing behind.
photos.colors: chocolate brown, white icing, pine green, warm gold
photos.notes: Portrait, atmospheric and sharp. The tin fills the lower two-thirds; the white cloth top left and soft bokeh above leave room for a caption. Crop to a square around the tin for the packaging checklist.

photos.alt: Two women in a warm, softly lit home kitchen kneading and rolling cookie dough on a counter, with a candle and fir branches behind them.
photos.notes: Two young women kneading and rolling gingerbread dough, both looking down at the counter (faces visible in profile, candid). Warm and calm, landscape; good beside the how-a-swap-works steps.

photos.alt: Three stacked gingerbread Christmas-tree cookies with green and white icing and star toppers, among gold baubles and warm blurred tree lights.
photos.notes: Second hero candidate: wide, sparkling and very festive. Text will need a scrim over the bokeh at the top.

photos.alt: Iced Christmas-tree cookies in green, white and gold, dusted with flour and scattered with sugar snowflakes on a light wooden board and a dark slate surface.
photos.notes: Texture and detail shot, portrait; flour and snowflakes make a good background for the sign-up sheet or a card.

photos.alt: Red and green iced mitten and boot cookies on a wire cooling rack, with glowing orange tree lights out of focus above them.
photos.notes: Atmosphere shot, portrait; warm bokeh fills the top, so it can host a heading. The cookies sit in the lower half.
